description.narrative: Svenskt stöd till etablerandet av en Teknisk Stöd Grupp bestående av Hälsoministeriet, PAHO och UNFPA. Gruppen ska stötta och stärka implementeringen av det svenska programbaserade stödet till hälsoministeriet i tre av de fattigaste regionerna i Guatemala. UNFPA ska ge kapacitetsbyggnadsstöd utifrån sitt mandat och expertis.

Swedish support to establish a Technical Support Group consisting of Ministry of Health, PAHO and UNFPA. The group shall support and strenthening the implementation of the Swedish programme-based support to the ministry of Health in three of the poorest regions in Guatemala. UNFPA shall give capacity building support based on its mandate and expertise.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Among the achievements are: -Increased capacity within MSPAS to carry out procedures aimed at improving the quality of care in public health services emphasizing maternal health, family planning, adolescents and youth as well as sexual gender based violence and HIV. Important pillars of sustainability are the institutionalization by the MSPAS of norms and maternal health care protocols. -The creation of a tracking and information platform has increased the capacity of the MSPAS to monitor and follow-up women´s sexual and reproductive health. -The MSPAS has a reliable supply of contraceptives ensuring the security of different kinds of contraceptives and reproductive health commodities for 2014. -The MSPAS has the capacity to address reproductive health in emergency situations.
